Name: Harvey's clinic sells candy.
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[b]Harvey's Clinic sells Candy.[/b]
Going to the doctors can be stressful, even if you have a good Doctor. Whether or not, you had to get a shot or died in the mines you deserve a treat. This mod adds candy you can buy from the clinic. Candy added for sale at the Clinic.:
Magic Rock Candy.
Miner's Treat.
Cranberry Candy.
Candy added that normally can only be gotten from the Movie Theater as a gift.:
Black Licorice //Loved by George, Krobus and Wizard.
Rock Candy // Loved by Abigail and Dwarf.
Cotten Candy // Loved by Penny and Sandy.
Sour Slimes // Loved by Jas.
Jaw Breaker // Loved by Vincent.

Russian translation by Vanlla1
Chinese translation by DistilledChickenBurger

Recolor available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30623]Bunny's Purple Concessions
[/url]
Translations are welcome. Just let me know. 
Insulation
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract Harvey's Clinic sells Candy into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley.

If you like this mod, please endorse it and take a look at my other mods.
